ValidationRule.description: Requires a Secondary value if the Primary = Billing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.SSV_PersonaServiceSupervisor), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupportEmergencyAfterHours", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupport"), ISPICKVAL(SSV_Primary__c, "NP_Billing"), ISBLANK(TEXT(SSV_Secondary__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Primary is Billing then you MUST provide a Secondary field value.
